name: list-item
title: List Item
description: Dense, Linear-style rows that also work as entity cards: List, ListGroup (label and count), ListItem with leading, title, subtitle, status, meta, trailing and actions, plus ListItemTitle, ListItemMeta, ListItemActions and IconTile. Agents get select(id).
docs: `List aria-label` holds `ListItem`s, optionally inside `ListGroup label count`. A row selects through a stretched link (`href`, `aria-current="page"` when `selected`) or a stretched UI SDK Button (`onSelect`), and its actions, chips and status stay their own targets. Give `List` a `value`, `defaultValue` or `onValueChange` and the rows become options of a UI SDK Listbox (arrow keys, one tab stop); options can't hold controls, so `actions` are ignored there. `variant="card"` lays rows out as cards in a responsive grid. Titles wrap to two lines, then show the full title in a tooltip; a status pill wraps below a narrow title, and trailing content and actions drop to their own line on a narrow row. `List onSelect(id, details)` runs before a row is chosen, for people and agents, and `details.cancel()` stops it. Agents see the list by its label with `select(id)`.
